1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __at least 600 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker comprising a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, or zirconium tetrahalide.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __selected from the group consisting of__ polyethylenimine, polypropylenimine, or poly(N,N-dimethyl aminoethyl methacrylate).

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, or zirconium tetrachloride.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __at least 600 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __selected from Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid that can comprise water, brine, or seawater.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where the fluid is __selected from the group consisting of__ brine, seawater, or fresh water.
